name: spendwise
description: AI-powered UPI expense tracker — monorepo (mobile, web, server, shared)

scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@spendwise/server
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@spendwise/server
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@spendwise/server
scripts.seed:categories: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:categories --workspace=@spendwise/server
